description.value: Pizza Pizza is a Canadian pizza chain founded in 1967 with over 750 locations coast to coast, operating here as a counter-service restaurant in a Burnaby strip unit along the busy Lougheed Highway corridor. The menu spans classic and specialty pizzas, panzerottis, poutine, chicken sandwiches, and sides. Indoor seating is available, and the kitchen offers plant-based, gluten-free, and vegetarian options, making it a practical calorie stop for cyclists moving through this part of Burnaby.
